title: Mater Lakes Academy, South Campus Phase I & II
address:
8851 NW 170th Street
Miami, Florida 33018
United States
description:
South Campus Phase I & II grew Mater Lakes Academy, a charter school in Miami-Dade County, through multiple stages of new construction. The work added multi-story classroom buildings to expand capacity for the school's middle and high school programs.

The two-story addition totals approximately 36,587 square feet and uses tilt-up construction, adding new classrooms, offices, and lockers. Site work included a man-made lake, a bus and parent drop-off area, surface parking lots, and exterior lighting and security around the perimeter of the facility.
